mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a comfortable 58 degrees with clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park. We are currently under a first quarter moon, and you can catch the International Space Station crossing our skies at 4:09 AM. It will rise over Belleville in the south-southwest and travel toward the east-northeast, passing near Fitchburg and Madison while reaching halfway up the sky.

In city news, Verona is making progress on the Mark Drive reconstruction project between North Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue. This extensive upgrade includes new water mains, storm sewers, and asphalt paving. Additionally, the city is conducting routine street rehabilitation projects to keep our roads in great shape, with work planned for areas like Monte Cristo Circle and Gateway Pass.

There is plenty to do around town. Today, Epic Systems is holding its UGM, and you can catch live music at the Century School Park Concerts in the Park or head to Hop Haus for trivia. Tomorrow, check out the live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In terms of public safety, police reported an incident from last Friday where a 29-year-old local man was arrested for his second O W I offence after being stopped for reckless driving.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store is currently closed, but they will open at 10:00 AM. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
